def find_sequence(N, B):
    # Initialize the sequence A with A1 = 0
    A = [0] * N
    
    # Use the matrix B to find the sequence A
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            if i != j:
                A[j] = B[i][j] - A[i]
    
    return A

def update_matrix(B, p, new_values):
    # Update the matrix B at row p and column p with new_values
    for i in range(len(B)):
        B[i][p] = B[p][i] = new_values[i]
    return B

def main():
    # Read the initial matrix B
    N, Q = map(int, input().split())
    B = [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(N)]
    
    # Find the initial sequence A
    A = find_sequence(N, B)
    print(*A)
    
    # Process each query
    for _ in range(Q):
        p = int(input()) - 1  # Convert to 0-based index
        new_values = list(map(int, input().split()))
        
        # Update the matrix B
        B = update_matrix(B, p, new_values)
        
        # Find the new sequence A
        A = find_sequence(N, B)
        print(*A)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
